task: Status filtering and failed-save recovery through the local Power Apps simulator
methodology: Actual Codex generation through local simulator MCP. Independent fresh contexts; reference edits removed. One trial per mode, not a statistical estimate. Token usage is client-reported, cached input is a subset of input. No model tokens are estimated from bytes. Manual interventions count human corrections during the task; automatic fixture setup and post-run verification/undo are excluded from agent metrics. Raw client and simulator logs remain local in the output directory. Usage excludes the coordinating chat. Full-document ran before focused; model prefix caching and sampling vary between runs. Existing workflows and reference edits were not modified.

diffs.diff:
--- Src/ai-development.pa.yaml
+++ Src/ai-development.pa.yaml
@@ -1,5 +1,4 @@
 # Fictional AI development benchmark starter. See examples/ai-development.task.json.
-# The requested status filter is absent; failed submission currently resets the form.
 App:
   Properties:
     StartScreen: =Workspace
@@ -19,6 +18,16 @@
             Height: =36
             Size: =26
             FontWeight: =FontWeight.Semibold
+      - StatusFilter:
+          Control: Classic/DropDown@2.3.1
+          Properties:
+            Items: =["All", "Draft", "Active"]
+            Default: ="All"
+            AccessibleLabel: ="Filter projects by status"
+            X: =24
+            Y: =70
+            Width: =192
+            Height: =32
       - ProjectCount:
           Control: ModernText@1.0.0
           Properties:
@@ -31,7 +40,7 @@
           Control: Gallery@2.15.0
           Variant: Vertical
           Properties:
-            Items: =Projects
+            Items: =Filter(Projects, StatusFilter.Selected.Value = "All" Or Status = StatusFilter.Selected.Value)
             X: =24
             Y: =120
             Width: =If(App.Width < 700, Parent.Width - 48, Parent.Width * 0.46 - 24)
@@ -88,7 +97,7 @@
             Height: =224
             NumberOfColumns: =1
             OnSuccess: =Set(selectedId, Self.LastSubmit.ID); Notify("Project saved", NotificationType.Success)
-            OnFailure: =ResetForm(ProjectForm)
+            OnFailure: =Notify("Could not save project. Your changes are preserved; please retry. " & Self.Error, NotificationType.Error)
           Children:
             - TitleCard:
                 Control: TypedDataCard@1.0.7
@@ -154,7 +163,7 @@
       - SaveFeedback:
           Control: ModernText@1.0.0
           Properties:
-            Text: =Coalesce(ProjectForm.Error, If(ProjectForm.Unsaved, "Unsaved changes", "Ready to edit"))
+            Text: =If(IsBlank(ProjectForm.Error), If(ProjectForm.Unsaved, "Unsaved changes", "Ready to edit"), ProjectForm.Error & " Please retry; your changes are preserved.")
             X: =ProjectForm.X
             Y: =SaveProject.Y + 44
             Width: =ProjectForm.Width
